review_text: The dress is even more beautiful in person! The fabric is light and airy, perfect for summer. It fits true to size and the colors are vibrant. Received so many compliments!
The material felt very thin and cheap after the first wash. Also, it shrunk a bit. Not what I expected for the price.
The jeans look nice and the denim quality is decent. However, they run very small. I usually wear a 28 but these felt more like a 26. Had to return.
Love the graphic on this tee! The XL fits me perfectly, not too tight and not too baggy. Cotton is soft. Delivery was quick too.
It's a decent windbreaker for casual use. Repels light rain. The Small is a bit snug if I wear a sweater underneath, but otherwise fine.
The dress I received is a dull maroon, not the vibrant red shown online. Very misleading! The fit was also awkward around the shoulders. Returning this immediately.
These loafers are fantastic. The leather is high quality, and they were comfortable right out of the box. True to size. Worth every penny.
The scarf has a beautiful pattern and the silk feels luxurious. It's a bit more delicate than I anticipated, so I have to be careful with it.
Wore these jeans twice and a hole appeared near the back pocket due to poor stitching. Really unhappy with the craftsmanship.
I'm in love with this skirt! The pleats are lovely, the color is exactly as pictured, and the medium fits perfectly. Great for work or casual outings.
The shirt looks nice and is breathable, but the linen fabric wrinkles incredibly easily. Needs constant ironing which is a hassle.
This jacket is surprisingly warm for how lightweight it is. The fit is flattering and I love the matte black finish. Pockets are a good size too.
These boots are very comfortable for walking, but the material scuffs more easily than I'd like. Otherwise, a great stylish boot.
My dress arrived with a noticeable tear along the seam. Packaging was also crushed. Very disappointed with the handling.
Simple, classic leather belt. The quality is excellent and the sizing is accurate. Smells like real leather. Happy with this purchase.

review_title: Soft and warm, good for layering
review_text: The sweater is very soft and provides good warmth. It's not too bulky, so it's great for layering. Fit is as expected.
The style of these trousers is nice and they are comfortable. However, the cream color is a bit see-through, requiring specific undergarments.
These sneakers are a huge hit! The lights are bright and she says they're super comfortable. Seem durable so far.
I ordered a white t-shirt and received a blue one with a completely different design. Customer service was slow to respond.
The material does not feel or look like genuine silk, more like a cheap polyester. The fit is also boxy. Not worth the premium price.
